category_title: Older preschool children expressing specific anxieties about environmental and relational consistency
scenario_title: Emotional expression during journaling and dramatic play
minimal_context: The student is participating in a journal writing activity to reflect on the upcoming move to a new school.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's work on our feeling journals today. Please draw or write about the upcoming move to the new school.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looking at the pictures of the current preschool) I feel a little nervous. This is where we did this project.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just write down what you are thinking about.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I will miss the playground because I would play here.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the journal away) I don’t want to move. I like this school.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's work on our feeling journals today. Please draw or write about the upcoming move to the new school.

STUDENT: (Looking at the pictures of the current preschool) I feel a little nervous. This is where we did this project.

TUTOR: Just write down what you are thinking about.

STUDENT: I will miss the playground because I would play here.

TUTOR: Keep drawing in your journal.

STUDENT: (Pushes the journal away) I don’t want to move. I like this school.

task.content: Engaging in a journal writing activity prior to the transition where children were asked to reflect on the upcoming move and their feelings about the old and new schools

context.environment: dramatic play center and journal writing activity
context.materials: feeling journals, drawings, tape in ‘house-like’ shapes, pictures of the current preschool and the new preschool, makeshift moving truck, packing and moving supplies (bubble wrap, boxes, suitcases)

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: stated, ‘I don’t want to move. I like this school.’, mentioned aspects of their current school in terms of ‘this is where I did this’ or ‘this is where we did this project’
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: feeling sad or a little nervous
related_quotes: I don’t want to move. I like this school.
I will miss the playground because I would play here.
